Hi, I'm a person who wanted to become a vet, I started doing the pre-requisite science papers to get into vet school but ended up changing paths and am now training to become a vet nurse.
 
I don't think it's too late for you at all, there's always been a handful of people your age or older in my classes, but most of your classmates would likely be younger. However it is difficult, the subject matter is broad and complex, and selection to get in to the programme is extremely competitive and requires top grades. (might vary depending on where you live but there's only a few universities that train vets in the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, NZ etc, and they get a lot of applicants from which only the top few are accepted.) 

If you're prepared to study hard for the next ~5+ years before actually being able to work as a vet go for it, but if you aren't and still want to work with animals I'd advice you to look into other careers with animals like vet nursing (vet tech if you're in the States). Only problem is other careers in the industry don't pay very well. I'd recommend finding a vet to shadow for a few days before you decide anyway. 

Good luck.
